summary: QA v15 Workstreams 1A, 1B, 1C, 2 verified end-to-end. Backend pytest 4/4 pass (shop products?category filter, apply/start with module=shop → SHOP tag in admin SHOP filter, default MART for backwards compat, module append on reused draft). Frontend: WK1A /shop/categories container is now width=1280 with symmetric left=320/right=320 on a 1920 viewport (mx-auto max-w-7xl). WK2 SEND rename: /send, /send/services, /send/book/location, /send/movers, /send/movers/wizard, /send/bookings all return 200 and render the correct SENDbakēd UI (SEND tab active). Legacy /express, /express/services, /express/book/location client-redirect (React <Navigate>) to their /send equivalent. Backend API /api/express/* still works (verified /api/express/vehicles → 200). WK1B code path verified: ProductCarouselSection triggers /api/shop/products?country=CI&category=<slug>&limit=12 when config.filter is a real category slug (falls back to shared list for filter=bestsellers|new|empty). Backend test confirmed the endpoint returns category-filtered items. Seeded homepage_sections for module=shop currently has one product_carousel with filter='new' (keyword) — no live category-scoped fetch fired, which is CORRECT per spec.
critical_code_review_comments: Legacy /express redirect is client-side (React <Navigate replace>), not a 302 HTTP redirect as the spec text suggests. The SPA server always returns 200 with the shell HTML. Behavior is user-equivalent (address bar updates to /send/*) but SEO crawlers and non-JS clients will not be redirected. If true 302 is required, add server-side rewrite/redirect at the ingress or FastAPI static handler level.
shared/suppliers/routes.py is now 1463 lines (grew ~80 lines since iteration_79 flagged 1381). Still well beyond the 700-line guideline — recommend the split noted in the last iteration.

ShopHome.jsx ProductCarouselSection issues a fresh /api/shop/products fetch on every section render when filter is a category slug — with N carousels this becomes N requests. Currently harmless (seed has 1 carousel) but consider batching or dedup via SWR/react-query once more SHOP carousels are curated.
